question: A student wants an RESP educational assistance payment to help cover rent and tools as well as tuition. Can the money be used for those costs, and who requests the payment?
generated_answer:
You can use RESP educational assistance payments to cover a variety of expenses, including rent, tools, tuition, and books. You can request the payment from the promoter of your RESP. If your RESP is a group plan, you may need to ask your group plan promoter if there are any additional requirements you need to meet before requesting your payment. When requesting your payment, you will need to provide the promoter with proof of enrollment and a written request for the payment. The promoter will then process the request and make the payment to you. You will need to declare the payment as income when you file your taxes for the year you receive the payment.
